company.name: Valink Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Valink Therapeutics develops drug discovery programs focused on bispecific antibody-drug conjugates designed for complex disease biology.
company.description: Valink Therapeutics researches multivalent and combinatorial target approaches intended to address treatment challenges in solid tumors and other therapeutic areas. Its work centers on identifying synergistic and less conventional target pairings and translating them into engineered biologic constructs with defined mechanisms of action. Valink Therapeutics operates as a therapeutics development organization that integrates antibody engineering, payload selection, and linker design within a single discovery framework.

aiResearchSummary.text: LiliumX is engaged in the development of multivalent protein scaffolds for therapeutic applications, as described in 'Multivalent proteins and screening methods.' Their research focuses on multi-domain polypeptide constructs with multiple binding domains and a structural domain, supporting the identification of new therapeutic compounds. These activities align with the company’s emphasis on discovering bispecific antibodies against cancer using a protein technology platform.
